description: OpenAI: GPT-6.1 Sol via OpenRouter. GPT-6.1 Sol is an upgrade to GPT-6 Sol from OpenAI, positioned below the flagship GPT-6 Astra in the GPT-6 series. It is suited for agentic coding, computer use, document-heavy professional

notes: AA intelligence 51.8 (no coding index); between terra (8.4) and sonnet-5.5 (8.6, II 56). Prices are OpenRouter list prices (per-token x 1e6) from /api/v1/models on 2026-10-25; they can differ per upstream provider. Context/max output are the top provider values. Latency is estimated: OpenRouter exposes no latency/throughput stats in the public API. Non-coding skill axes derived from coding theta with fixed offsets (tweaked per model), not measured. verified (attempt-grade 2026-10): axes planning 8.4->9.18 fitted (1PL IRT, router scale) from single-turn, no-tool attempts on non-SWE tasks, graded by deepseek-v4.1-flash (kappa 0.85 vs kimi-k3.1-pro); applied only where the direction also holds under gpt-6.1-sol grading. Location anchored on the 5 attempters' own card means (deltas are relative to their consensus). Other axes and supersedes unchanged.
